sm_top.sm: Missiles hit Aden airport while the Saudi-led coalition intercepted a missile headed for Yanbu.
A ballistic missile strike on a military training camp in Yemen killed at least 58 to 73 people.
The United Kingdom is deploying Typhoon fighter jets and transport aircraft to Saudi Arabia to assist in defense against Houthi attacks.
The Arab coalition reported intercepting and destroying 11 drones targeting four regions in Saudi Arabia.
A drone strike on a market in Abyei killed at least 153 people.
Two people were killed by falling drone debris near the Shaybah oilfield in Saudi Arabia.
Russia and Ukraine exchanged heavy missile and drone strikes resulting in casualties.
Russian missile and drone attacks across Ukraine killed at least 16 people and injured 69.
Houthi missile and drone attacks on Riyadh airport resulted in casualties and air defense activity.
The IRGC claimed tankers caught fire after hitting mines in the Strait of Hormuz, while US CENTCOM rejected the claims.
British counterterrorism police rearrested two men in London over a suspected Iranian-backed plot targeting RAF Fairford.
Israeli airstrikes in Gaza killed several Palestinians, including a police captain.
Two ships sink near the Strait of Hormuz after being hit by projectiles.
A Houthi missile hit a residential area in Taiz, Yemen, killing two teenage girls.
A paramilitary drone strike near the Ethiopian border in Sudan killed 41 people, according to a rights group.
Drone strikes and interceptions are reported in Khartoum and across Sudan.
Yemeni military forces report ongoing airstrikes against Houthi fighters, with varying casualty figures reported over recent days.
Iran reported that seven oil tankers were damaged in the Strait of Hormuz amid regional tensions.
The Kremlin warned Germany of new attacks after an attempt to blow up a Ukrainian aircraft in Leipzig.
At least 40 civilians were killed in northern Mali following attacks attributed to the Islamic State.
The Saudi coalition intercepted and destroyed a drone launched toward Saudi Arabia's Eastern Province.
Russian drone strikes on Korotych, Kharkiv Oblast, leave two people dead and eleven wounded.
Russian missile and drone strikes across Ukraine killed two people and injured 34.
A drone attack targeting the Shaybah oilfield in Saudi Arabia resulted in casualties among workers.
The U.S. is deploying additional warships and Marines to the Middle East amid rising tensions with Iran.
Ukrainian forces reportedly struck Russia's 75th Arsenal near Serpukhov, a facility repairing air defense systems.
Drone attacks were reported targeting cargo ships in the Black Sea.
Islamic State-linked militants killed at least 48 civilians in eastern Mali.
Drone strikes on a market in a disputed Sudanese town left more than 150 people dead.
Oil prices surged above $111 as Houthi forces struck Saudi targets.
A funeral was held in Shabwah for about 75 security personnel killed in a Houthi missile attack.
Persisting shipping risks in the Strait of Hormuz drive up oil prices.
Russia launched missile attacks against Kyiv following reports of peace talks.
Russian MoD claims drone strikes hit the Novokyivska substation in Hotiv, the Zhytomyrska substation in Zhytomyr, and two dry cargo ships.
The Gaza death toll from Israeli operations rises to 74,498, with over 175,000 injured.
Moscow reports that Russian air defenses downed 808 Ukrainian drones overnight.
An attack on buses in northern Niger leaves 12 people dead.
Houthis strike Saudi-led coalition targets after Saudi airstrikes across Yemen killed eight fishermen.
A drone strike damaged eight of twelve storage tanks at the Novoshakhtinsk Oil Products Plant.
Russian air defense intercepted and destroyed 373 Ukrainian drones overnight across multiple regions and the Black Sea.
